gen-gf-tapestry-fs-synonym: Relaxed and personal, Tapestry writes like a quick note in the margin. Synonym follows in a plain sans stripe with generous curve openings, comfortable in small doses.
gen-gf-tapestry-outfit: Tapestry looks hand-drawn, its crossbars as thick as its uprights. Outfit, in clean sans-serif curves that stop short of closing, is better for a quick look than for long paragraphs, while Tapestry carries the personality.
gen-gf-tapestry-plus-jakarta-sans: Hand-drawn strokes with crossbars matching the uprights give Tapestry its loose, personal charm, especially when big and brief. Plus Jakarta Sans lands modern and precise, a monoline sans with curve endings held well apart, made for short stretches of reading.
gen-gf-tapestry-sora: Loose, handmade, and friendly. Sora keeps its sans-serif curves precise and geometric, with no swelling at the corners, which makes a stretch of reading feel tidy and light after Tapestry's casual lettering.
gen-gf-tapestry-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk is geometric and neutral, built from a ribbon of constant width. Tapestry is best at relaxed, hand-drawn personality, while the sans-serif body is best at opening its counters for short stretches of reading.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: BhuTuka Expanded One is a literary text serif with thin joins as sturdy as its stems. Tektur adds expressive, outsized lowercase above it, and BhuTuka slows the pace to a leisurely walk below.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-hepta-slab: Hepta Slab reads bookish and dignified, stretched out with counters that breathe into the white space. Tektur's pipe-cleaner strokes and outsized lowercase sit above a text serif whose lines hold one thickness, so a longer read feels unhurried.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-kiwi-maru: Wired, oversized, and a bit odd. Kiwi Maru brings editorial, traditional serif manners, with terminals stopping far from the stem and generous letterspace, which makes the gap in lowercase height the pair's best trick.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Tektur's pipe-cleaner strokes and outsized lowercase give it an expressive, distinctive look, but shrink it and that charm fades. Padyakke Expanded One would feel loose if enlarged.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Stint Ultra Expanded floats each serif character apart from its neighbors. Tektur's outsized lowercase and pipe-cleaner strokes above that traditional, authoritative serif make the difference in lowercase height the pair's strongest quality.
